sol-3-1.summary: SpawnRecord accepts invalid additional-FD stream/sink payloads under numeric-template keys such as "fd 3" and "fd0x3" because the narrower S.Finite key template skips their value validation.
sol-3-1.fix: Replace the additional-FD key schema with one covering core's full fd${number} key domain so every matching entry is validated by the existing input/output configuration union. Preserve the original options object and its opaque stream/sink carriers. In scratchpad/test/commands/ScriptedSpawner.test.ts add guard and decoder regressions proving that "fd 3" and "fd0x3" accept valid input/output configurations and reject invalid stream/sink payloads; retain canonical fd3/fd4 cases and options-object identity assertions. Keep D15 compliance, using the module's deliberatelyInvalid helper if a wrong-input cast is necessary.
